addressZero.note: What a table index of 0 walks, and what the player writes as the noise period (the byte at $000001). On an ST these are the TOS ROM header, so they belong to the TOS the capture ran, not to the game.

notes: The three voices of the resident player at $033F6A, each to the jump that closes its loop.
Every non-null volume and pitch table the pointer tables at $034FB0 and $03501A hold.
